title: Max Rebo
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: A master of the red ball jett organ, the two-limbed, blue Ortolan named Max Rebo was the leader of the band that bore his name. He booked gigs for the Max Rebo band and kept them playing at some of the sweetest gigs on this side of the Outer Rim territories. They even played a gig at Jabba's Palace on Tatooine just before the gangster was murdered by the friends of a smuggler who owed him money.
